issues: used numbers the simulation did not produce

text:
In this what-if simulation, the one change that helps wheelchair users on everyday trips is building a step-free ramp at a set of unnamed steps. Confirmed routes would rise from 1 to 3 across the sampled everyday trips. The number of trips that can be reached would stay the same. No second change added anything in the model: a staff check of an unnamed ramp's incline gives the same result, and combining the two gives the same result too.
Worth knowing:
• Imagined changes are not real; unverified facts stay unverified.
• Segment facts are demo values, not yet surveyed.
• The search found no useful second change: the staff incline check only ties with the ramp, and the two together do no better than the ramp alone.
